integration_findings.finding: Only the 50 legacy recipe IDs are read; new source recipe IDs return NOT_FOUND for detail/calculation.

integration_findings.finding: Role catalog requires IDs 1..50; diet certification uses legacy snapshots. Imported role/diet observations have no reviewed publication reader.
integration_findings.required_change: Read explicitly reviewed revision-bound role/diet evidence for v2 publication; do not add new IDs into the legacy 50-ID classifier or mark drafts VERIFIED.

integration_findings.finding: Imported quantity entity_ref is revision:<revision_id>:<line_no>; calculator proof requires line:<revision_id>:<line_no>. A status change cannot fix this.
integration_findings.required_change: Before quantity approval, add canonical line-scoped evidence and bind the exact reviewed subject hash. Preserve original observations and importer replay safety; do not loosen _proofs or rewrite reviewed evidence.

integration_findings.finding: Release members are selected and exposed by legacy_recipe_id; all six source recipes deliberately have no legacy identity.
integration_findings.required_change: Explicitly support public v2 recipe identities in the adapter and pinned release selection. Never invent a legacy mapping.

coverage_if_all_six_pass_review_and_inte.people_2_4_6_8: Count coverage only; ingredient, time and pin filters can still make a meal impossible.
coverage_if_all_six_pass_review_and_inte.people_8_note: Both mains and both vegetables are required. A pinned recipe in such a group may have no alternative for replacement.

review_steps: Review the selected variant, full components (including seasonings, optional and instruction-only items) and source notes for each recipe; decide missing product compositions and unresolved fields. Start with V02/V12.

Record a real reviewer identity/date, claim scope/entity, evidence set and canonical subject hash. Source, content, role and diet are distinct decisions; quantities/forms/units/scaling/portion allocation are further distinct decisions.

Correct canonical quantity evidence bindings before quantitative approval. Any unsupported quantity or incomplete component remains NEEDS_VERIFICATION; keep INCOMPLETE for real calculation as required.

Implement/test an inactive release-gated v2 reader end to end, then publish and activate only an explicitly reviewed release when instructed. Enable Chay only for headcounts with enough eligible distinct recipes.
